title: A rep with the switch off is not copied to a new work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Staff members {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B} are active at {Location-A}. {Sales-rep-A}'s "Sales Representative" switch is on; {Sales-rep-B}'s was on and has since been turned off (the staff account is still active).
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-B} as its one sales representative, picked while their switch was on.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  2. Create a new work order for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Customer-A} still shows {Sales-rep-B}, reading "{Sales-rep-B} (Inactive)".
  • Step 2: the new work order's Sales Representative reads "Unassigned".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R27: “Only a staff member whose account is active and whose Sales Representative switch is on is copied (S1-R8). Anyone else leaves that field "Unassigned", and S4-R17 and S4-R18 still apply at invoicing.”
  • S4-N2: “Turning off a staff member's Sales Representative switch, without deactivating their account, leaves them in the customer fields they hold, as today. In Edit Customer and on the customer page their name reads followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)", as on the work order (S1-E2). They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”
  • Story 4 context note (S4-R27, S4-N2): “* Context note (S4-R27, S4-N2): a person whose Sales Representative switch is off but whose account is active can stay in a customer field (S4-N2). A new work order does not copy them, so its card reads "Unassigned", but when it is invoiced with nobody on it, S4-R17 still credits them from the customer. QA should expect both.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 14: “14. (b) "Name (Inactive)", as on a work order. Yes, no option is ticked while they hold the field.”
